CERT-In Vulnerability Note CIVN-2026-0529
SQL Injection Vulnerability in Radius Xenia M2M Platform

Original Issue Date:October 27, 2026

Severity Rating: HIGH

Systems Affected

  • Radius Xenia M2M Platform

Overview

A vulnerability has been reported in Radius Xenia M2M Platform, which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to sensitive information, or modify database records on the targeted system.

Target Audience:
End-users/ Administrators of Radius Xenia M2M Platform.

Risk Assessment:
Manipulation of application logic and information disclosure.

Impact Assessment:
Gain sensitive information, enumerate or modify database records.
